title: Do not speak with contempt where Guru speaks with honor
summary: This is a corrective for inherited disrespect and casual dismissal.
takeaway: Guru's language should shape your social instincts too.
lifeApplication: Examine one attitude you carry that Gurbani would ask you to unlearn.

source.shortMeaning: Guru Nanak directly rejects contempt toward women.
source.lifeApplication: Let reverence revise the way you speak about people.

evidence.coreClaim: Guru Nanak directly rejects contempt toward women.
evidence.turn: What Guru honors cannot be spoken of with contempt.
evidence.practicalImplication: Examine one attitude you carry that Gurbani would ask you to unlearn.
